scene: First Austin Ganesh Chaturthi home shrine. Buddy gently puts his familiar small squeaky toy BONE at the feet of a low red-and-gold Ganesha murti on a sturdy low shrine platform; toy held at its edge then just set down, no bite of deity. His full dark elongated body and planted feet visible in side three-quarter angle, neck extended naturally. Neet sits beside shrine watching with softened serious expression, broad ears and connected body visible. Marigold garland, crimson/gold cloth, brass lamp placed safely up/back on platform, simple office bookshelf background. Respectful warm domestic devotional scene, not grand temple. Humor and affection from the heartfelt squeaky offering rather than sweets. No written speech/text, no human faces, no extra dogs.
placement_after: “An offering!” he barked proudly. He nudged the bone until its squeaker faced the new guest.
alt_text: Buddy offers his squeaky bone to Ganesha while Neet quietly approves.

No long tail, shag, high white socks, black saddle, giant eyes or puppy head. Buddy has a full moderately elongated continuous charcoal close-coated torso, deep chest, visible neck and genuine leg clearance on substantial legs. Modest projecting muzzle, cream moustache/beard, light curved brows, tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet, softly pendant ears. No floor-length body shag, square generic terrier, dachshund-short legs or oversized head. Human appearances if visible are provisional story design, no claimed likeness. B04/B24 one exposure, only B04 here. Do not copy photo backgrounds. No costume/collar/extra objects unless specified by actual scene.
